Retain glass at discrete points or edges; Keep exposed edges safe and finished; Transfer actions through fittings or joints

cad_attributes.repetition_pattern: Exposed glass edges with scheduled discrete supports
cad_attributes.typical_placement: At floors, walls, doors or wet-area fittings
cad_attributes.opening_relationship: Glass forms the enclosure or screen
cad_attributes.load_bearing_role: Actions concentrated at fittings and joint supports

notes: Do not infer hole positions, notch geometry or glass type; these belong to an engineered or supplied assembly.

definition_plain: A permanent contrasting band, motif, dots or other visible marking applied to transparent glazing so people can recognise the presence of a door, panel or wall of glass.
primary_function: Make transparent glazing conspicuous
Reduce accidental human impact
Provide a repeatable visual cue across the required glass area
typical_materials: durable applied marking or other documented system

standard_references.relationship: Referenced or supporting technical standard for this object family; exact rules require the applicable licensed edition and project inputs.

ncc_references.relationship: Certain glass doors and panels capable of being mistaken for an opening require a contrasting visible marking.
